payload.description:
## Intent

`limatus scan` is the article-body pass. Title and subtitle are a later HITL pass (`limatus headline options`). The OpenAI judge currently sees the raw file, so rubric evidence cites the YAML title and body findings stay empty.

## DoD

- Judge user prompt blanks leading YAML the same way the profile lane does (same-length mask; offsets stay valid).
- System prompt states this is the body pass; do not score title/standfirst/description.
- Findings and rubric evidence whose spans fall inside frontmatter are dropped.
- `JUDGE_PROMPT_VERSION` and canary pin bump together.
- Unit (and Gherkin if a scenario exists) cover: title string is not in the judge prompt; a mocked finding inside YAML is dropped.

Out of scope: changing headline HITL; Papyrus adapter.
payload.title: Judge body scan must ignore YAML title/standfirst
